content: I found MLList and I was wondering, are there any other similar examples of unsafe types that are wrapped in a public API such that the API's core definitions can in practice be used as if they were primitives? I'm also more generally interested in any type whose public API is completely separated from the Lean primitives used to define it. I'm trying to write an ergonomic implementation of non-empty lists written as subtypes of normal lists but the match elaborator won't accept the obvious match_pattern-annotated constructors for it, so I'm looking for inspiration on how people have worked around this sort of constraint.
